period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the 'Statement of Financial Position (Unaudited) as on 31 March 2013' and 'Statement of Comprehensive Income (Unaudited) for the period ended 31 March 2013' blocks (distinct from the 'Consolidated Statement of Financial Position' and 'Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income' blocks on the same infographic page; legal name at the time was BRAC Bank Limited). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo). Consolidated cross-reference (same date, for comparison only, NOT used as primary): Total Assets 181,607 BDT_million, Total Liabilities 169,775, Total shareholders' equity (BRAC Bank Ltd) 11,400, Minority interest 432, Total equity 11,832, consolidated PAT 512 (attributable to BRAC Bank Ltd equity holders 349; minority -18), consolidated EPS 1.38. Balance sheet identity (solo) reconciles exactly: 159,380 (Total Liabilities) + 10,747 (Total Equity) = 170,127 (Total Property and Assets). Every P&L subtotal reconciles to within BDT 1 million (rounding). Note: comparative March-2012 EPS shown elsewhere in this filing's consolidated statement (0.99) is lower than the 1.19 originally reported for that period in the 2012 Q1 filing itself — this is the expected retrospective EPS restatement for the ~20% bonus share issue between the two periods (paid-up capital rose from BDT 3,212mn to 3,855mn, ratio 1.20; 1.19/1.20≈0.99), not a profit restatement; each quarter in this dataset uses its own originally-filed EPS, so no correction was needed here.
